title: Build
description: Runs dotnet build or dotnet publish once over a generated traversal project of every batched project, restoring inside the run, letting MSBuild order the projects, and reporting each project's own result

command.description: dotnet verb and its switches for the configuration, which the plugin infers

outputs.description: Folders and files the configuration writes, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to the dotnet command
